verdict.rationale: Docs confirm per-merchant deposit frequency can be configured and updated via the API (rainforest-docs-7), supporting scheduled payouts per seller, but there is no evidence of instant/real-time payouts to cards or push-to-card rails, nor explicit mention of daily/weekly/monthly/manual options as distinct settings. missing for 10: instant payouts to cards or real-time rails, explicit enumeration of daily/weekly/monthly/manual schedule options, and any confirmation of per-seller instant payout support.
